# HiJSON

> Free in-browser JSON parser at https://hijson.online — format, minify, tree view, JSONPath. Parsing stays in the browser unless the user shares or uses AI.

HiJSON is a single-page tool plus written guides. Core parse / format / tree / JSONPath do not upload JSON to HiJSON servers.

## Tool

- [HiJSON](https://hijson.online/): paste JSON on the left, get a tree on the right. Optional JSONBin share (`?bin=`) and optional BYO LLM.

## Guides (Chinese)

- [教程中心](https://hijson.online/guide.html)
- [格式化与压缩](https://hijson.online/guide/json-formatting.html): when to pretty-print vs minify
- [JSONPath 入门](https://hijson.online/guide/jsonpath.html): `$`, filters, recursive descent
- [API 调试实践](https://hijson.online/guide/api-debugging.html): read a response, extract fields
- [语法错误排查](https://hijson.online/guide/json-errors.html): trailing commas, quotes, comments, NaN
- [树视图怎么读](https://hijson.online/guide/json-tree.html): objects vs arrays, copy a path
- [JSONL 与日志](https://hijson.online/guide/jsonl-logs.html): one object per line
- [大 JSON 不卡](https://hijson.online/guide/large-json.html): import files, slice with jq
- [JSON Schema](https://hijson.online/guide/json-schema.html): types and required fields
- [JSON / YAML / XML](https://hijson.online/guide/json-vs-yaml.html)
- [JS / Python / Go](https://hijson.online/guide/json-in-languages.html): stringify/parse differences
- [安全注意](https://hijson.online/guide/json-security.html): local parse vs share/AI
